questions.prompt: How will the programme help communities?
options: It will help families pay for meals at selected restaurants.
It will help local leaders develop food support for their areas.
It will help vegetable sellers find new markets abroad.
It will help food businesses train staff for school kitchens.
questions.explanationZh: 正文说明资金交给地方政府，地方领导者按社区需要选择食物支持措施；没有餐厅餐费补贴、海外销售或学校厨房员工培训的安排。

questions.prompt: How much funding will each local authority receive?
questions.explanationZh: 近1,000万英镑是总额；每个地方政府获得222,000英镑。

questions.prompt: Which activities does the article give as examples?
questions.explanationZh: 正文举例包括午餐俱乐部和烹饪课程；其他选项虽与食物相关，但不是文中列出的活动。
